en.1fc7334c: Do not take this medicine if you have breathing disorders such as emphysema, chronic bronchitis, or asthma, glaucoma, or an enlarged prostate, are breastfeeding, or are a child 15 years old or younger. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are pregnant or may be pregnant. Excessive sedation may occur after taking this medicine, so use caution when driving or operating machinery. Do not take this medicine for more than 2 weeks without consulting a doctor or pharmacist.
